newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares hit new records on U.S. payroll data.
newsitem.headline: German shares hit new records on U.S. payroll data.

text.p: 1238 GMT - German shares jump to set new records in electronic trade after eagerly-awaited U.S. payroll data for U.S. show rise of 142,000 versus average expectations of 211,000, and jobless rate at 4.9 percent versus forecasts for 5.2 percent. Activity had been muted all day as German market waited for the data. Bunds shoot higher on news.
* IBIS DAX index up 45.65 at 3,483.74, past old record at 3,475.18 points. Spiked to new high of 3,504.27.
* DAX ended bourse mid-afternoon at 3,460.37 points.
* June DTB DAX futures up 49 at 3,501 points.
